I searched Apple.com for 'Smart Folio for iPad' and found the product **Smart Folio for iPad (A16) – Sky** priced at **$79.00**. The product is available in multiple colors: Sky, White, Watermelon, and Lemonade.

However, I was **unable to check the store pickup availability near zip code 90038**. When attempting to use the 'Pick up at an Apple Store near you' feature in the shopping bag (which requires entering a zip code), every attempt to submit zip code 90038 resulted in a 404 error page on Apple's website. I tried multiple approaches:
1. Clicking the Apply button after entering the zip code
2. Pressing Enter after entering the zip code
3. Multiple sessions/page reloads

All attempts consistently redirected to apple.com/shop/404.

To check pickup availability manually, you can:
1. Go to https://www.apple.com/shop/bag
2. Add the Smart Folio for iPad (A16) to your bag
3. Look for 'Pick up at an Apple Store near you' and enter zip code 90038

Alternatively, you can use the Apple Store app or call 1-800-MY-APPLE to check store availability near zip code 90038 (Los Angeles, CA area).
